Name: Simply Shirtless
Author: Brukob
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=6][b][color=#FFE4C4][center]﻿[font=Trebuchet MS][size=6][b][color=#FFE4C4]Simply Shirtless

[/color][/b][/size][/font][img]https://i.imgur.com/ToDKSUa.gif[/img]﻿[/center][/color][/b][/size][/font][size=5][color=#FFE4C4]Key Features[/color][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Free your chest![/b]
We were tired of our farmer being perpetually stuck in a undershirt. Hence Simply Shirtless, the mod that allows the farmers to roam the fields shirtless without the game's default undershirt interference. This also means you're not stuck to a single colored chest-like shirt, you'll see your actual skin.[*][b]Smart Sleeves[/b]
Traditional Content Patcher mods often struggle with the dynamic painting of shirt sleeves. Simply Shirtless ingeniously sidesteps this issue by specifically making the shirtless look sleeveless instead of removing all sleeves, this ensures you won't need to set when to remove sleeves.[*][b]Torso Options[/b]
Since the farmer wasn't designed to go shirtless we made a custom muscular appearance, though you can still choose the sleek silhouette option. A third option including extra muscles is intended for future updates.[*][b]Multiplayer Compatibility[/b]
Simply Shirtless works seamlessly in multiplayer, taking advantage from SV's inherent farmer rendering functions, this means different skin colors for each farmer. All while fetching each player's own sprite option.[/list]
[size=4][color=#FFE4C4]Version 0.2.0[/color][/size]
- Added support for female farmers.
- Texture options for women farmers are still a work in progress. Any config set currently will default to the "flat" option.
- Fixed bug that would slow performance.


[size=5][color=#FFE4C4]Planned[/color][/size]

[color=#FFE4C4][b]Simply Shirtless[/b][/color] is still in early stages and has not officially released. Planned features that are currently being developed:
[list]
[*][b]Multiplayer Sprite[/b] fetching
Setting each player torso sprite independently through SMAPI's Mod Message API.[*][b]The chiseled body[/b]
A third sprite option with even more muscles.[/list]

[size=5][color=#FFE4C4]Install[/color][/size]

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io][color=#FFA07A]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/color][/url].
[*]Download Simply Shirtless and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5][color=#FFE4C4]How to use
[/color][/size]
Unzipping the mod into the Mods folder is enough, but if you want to configure the mod in-game you can use the GenericModConfigMenu Mod Options:

[list]
[*]Go to Options > Scroll to the bottom and click Mod Options > Choose Simply Shirtless
[/list]
You can also use the Main Menu Mod Options or manually configure it in the config.json file if you don't have GMCM.


[size=5][color=#FFE4C4]Compatibility[/color][/size]

[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
[*]Works seamlessly in single-player and multiplayer.
[/list]
